thread:
alejandra: alerting: small but consistent spike in ptls handshake failures from eu-edge -> backend-pool after the midnight rotator run. seen at 2025-10-12T00:02Z. failures: `x509: certificate signed by unknown authority` on ~0.6% of flows.
devin: did rotator publish any partial chains? last time that happened it was an intermediate unwrap failure. which KMS key did rotator use?
qin: digging audit logs now. rotator-service had successful kms:Decrypt in us-west, but in eu-west calls started returning DENY exactly at 00:01:23Z. RBAC change 1754321000 earlier tightened kms:Decrypt to exclude the rotator role temporarily during a deploy window.
rolf: so rotator probably re-published leaf certs without the intermediate for eu region. quick mitigation: can we requeue a republish with `--include-intermediates` and force reload at proxies?
rotator-bot: republish job enqueued (id 8917) for eu regions, starting in 30s.
alejandra: thanks. also adding a short-term proxy flag to accept fallback full-chain served by previous version (expires in 1h) to reduce surface.
devin: follow-ups: add an automated post-publish probe that visits a sample of proxies in each region and validates chain length and issuer validity. if probe fails, mark rotation run as failed and auto-rollback.
qin: action: add an audit alert rule for KMS Decrypt Deny spikes per region (>3 denies/min) and correlate with rotator job ids. I'll file the alert PR.
rolf: we should also create an RBAC rollback snippet in runbooks: commands to restore kms:Decrypt for rotator and to re-run a publish job. I'll draft that.
alejandra: incident ticket INC-175432 was opened and page fired to eng-oncall. after republish, error rate dropped to ~0.01% within 90s. keeping an eye.
devin: one more defensive: expand rotator integration tests to simulate IAM denies and ensure it fails safe (do not publish incomplete chains). add local verification of unwrap + chain assembly before publish.
qin: noted. I'll attach the audit log slices and the RBAC change PR link to the incident.
rolf: ownership: rotator devs own the probe + test changes, security owns the alert and runbook, oncall owns the fallback proxy flag. set eta EOD.
alejandra: closing loop: will run a canary rotation in apac next maintenance window and then schedule a global run after verification.
oncall-bot: INC-175432 status -> RESOLVED (monitoring).
alejandra: thanks everyone. adding retrospective note to the rotation playbook about KMS propagation delays and RBAC timing windows. :thumbsup:
